data.title: Agentic AI: A Survey on Autonomous Intelligent Systems
data.abstract: This survey provides a comprehensive overview of Agentic AI, including architectures, planning strategies, memory mechanisms, tool usage, and real-world applications. It discusses current challenges and future research directions.

data.title: Large Language Model Agents: A Comprehensive Survey
data.abstract: This paper reviews LLM-based autonomous agents, covering reasoning, planning, memory, tool invocation, multi-agent collaboration, and evaluation benchmarks.
